DEC-21 k-of-n pallet_multisig custody for sudo, usdtOwner and all 12 pallet admins (admins[].pallet is the closed AdminPallet set); each carries address, threshold and signatories. Multisig custody applies to every purpose and every ladder rung (Keel, Chi, Genie, Psi, Omega); there is no single-key rehearsal exception (yvan 2026-09-14). Validation requires 2 <= threshold <= n <= 20 (runtime MaxSignatories); signatories unique and strictly ascending by AccountId32 bytes; no signatory or address that is a forgeable public key, refused before any signature check and regardless of scheme: the all-zero sr25519 Ristretto identity or any ed25519 small-order encoding, canonical or not (custody_pop_weak_key, CR3-01); every ed25519 signatory key a canonical, torsion-free, non-identity point (ed25519_key_not_prime_order, decision A of yvan 2026-09-14 05:46 UTC, curve25519-dalek 4.1.3), so one secret cannot stand as several signatories through torsion twins; no signatory equal to its own multisig address or to another role's address in this document; no address or signatory equal to ammAccount, miningPoolAccount, any b"modl" PalletId account, any validators[].account or any validator session key; no well-known development key as address or signatory; and address == multisig_account(signatories, threshold) = blake2_256(SCALE(b"modlpy/utilisuba", sorted Vec<AccountId32>, u16 threshold)), verified against pallet-multisig 45.0.0 multi_account_id (the version d9-v2-node pins; 48.0.0 is byte-identical) (yvan 2026-09-14, CS-1 = A). This is intentionally the second of two implementations: d9-v2-tools d9-bootstrap derive-admins keeps its own copy because the key-generation binary must not depend on this crate (sp-core); both are pinned to the same @polkadot/util-crypto golden vectors and d9-v2-tools d9-genesis-composition custody::cross_check_derivations (tools PR #72, not yet merged) cross-checks them. Roles (yvan 2026-09-14, CS-4): sudo.address differs from usdtOwner.address and from every admins[].multisig.address; the 12 pallet admins may share one multisig and usdtOwner may equal an admin multisig. Independence (yvan 2026-09-14 04:34 UTC, supersedes the 03:33 allowance of sudo/admin signatory overlap): sudo.signatories are disjoint from the signatories of usdtOwner and every admin (usdtOwner is the admin side); a signatory may still appear in several admin-side multisigs. Disjointness subsumes the quorum-containment predicate (CS2-3), which is therefore not implemented separately. The deny list is every URI below in sr25519 and ed25519 public keys plus the ecdsa account blake2_256(compressed public key): //Alice, //Bob, //Charlie, //Dave, //Eve, //Ferdie, each //stash, //One, //Two and the bare DEV_PHRASE root (sp-keyring 48.0.0, sp-core 43.0.0); d9's own committed authority SURIs //LocalValidator1..6 (d9-v2-node e13a19d runtime/src/genesis_config_presets.rs LOCAL_DEV_*_PUBS, local-keys/README.md), //Mainnet0..5//{stash,babe,imon,audi,live,grandpa} and //OCWTest//{Babe,Grandpa,Liveness,Discovery} (183 keys). The producer projects sudo.key, each <pallet>.admin and the asset 1 owner from these addresses; other declared asset owners equal sudo.address (node MainnetAssetOwners). Proof-of-possession (yvan 2026-09-14 04:34 UTC): every signatory carries {address, evidence}, where evidence is exactly one of signature {scheme sr25519|ed25519, signature} or enclaveAttested {attestationDocument, expectedPcr0, popMessageSha256}. Raw proofs only (decision D, 05:46 UTC): a signature verifies (sp-core sr25519 context b"substrate" or ed25519) over custody_pop_message = b"D9-V2-CUSTODY-POP/1" || for each of network label, chain.id, CustodyRole label (sudo|usdtOwner|admin/<pallet>), multisig address, signatory public key, custody.ceremonyNonce: u64 big-endian length || bytes; there is no wrapped form, and unknown schemes (including ecdsa) or a message field are decode errors. Any change of network, chain id, role, multisig, signatory or nonce invalidates it (custody_pop_invalid). Custodians sign the raw message with an offline, domain-specific tool that displays the decoded fields; browser or dApp signRaw proofs are not accepted. The contract explicitly refuses only the forgeable and non-prime-order keys above; other keyless accounts (pure proxies, derivatives, external multisigs) fail only because nobody can sign for them. PoP proves a key exists and is held, not that the holder is the intended custodian, which remains ceremony evidence. Enclave-held signatories, in any role (yvan 2026-09-14 04:57 UTC), use enclaveAttested: the signer's attest mode requests an NSM attestation with user_data = custody_pop_message_sha256(...), emitting no signature and leaving its extrinsic allowlist unchanged. Per role at most threshold - 1 signatories may be enclaveAttested (custody_attested_quorum, decision B). The contract checks structure (non-empty canonical padded base64 of at most 16 KiB decoded, 96-hex non-zero expectedPcr0, 64-hex popMessageSha256; custody_pop_attestation_malformed), the binding popMessageSha256 == SHA-256(custody_pop_message) (custody_pop_attestation_binding), and expectedPcr0 in BLESSED_SIGNER_PCR0 (custody_attestation_pcr0_not_blessed, decision C). A measurement is added only by a new contract RC after it is recorded in d9-v2-docs docs/operations/pcr0-ledger for the blessed signer EIF; the set is empty until the mainnet sudo-signer attest-mode EIF (CUS-221) is built and blessed, so enclave-attested custody cannot pass until then. The contract does not verify attestations: accepted enclaveAttested signatories are listed in the report's pendingAttestationVerifications, check becomes input-contract-conformance;attestation-verification-pending, and the producer must verify each document with d9-enclave-common attest_verify (COSE signature, certificate chain to the pinned AWS Nitro root validated at the document's own timestamp, PCR0 == expectedPcr0, user_data == popMessageSha256), with expectedPcr0 equal to the blessed signer measurement recorded in the PCR0 ledger.

The contract declares chain network (mainnet|testnet), id, name and chainType (Development|Local|Live; Custom is refused). migration-input requires Live; only migration-input may be labelled mainnet; testnet-labelled migration-input stays valid for rehearsal. id is 1-64 of [a-z0-9_]; name is nonempty printable ASCII (0x20-0x7E) without surrounding whitespace. Mainnet id and name exclude the substrings test/dev/local/rehears/fixture/synthetic (case-insensitive); testnet id and name contain test. The producer must require the bootstrap manifest network and the chain-spec id, name and chainType to equal this declaration, and must reject any bootNodes entry and any telemetryEndpoints value other than null. Label consistency is not proof of which network a spec is deployed to.

bootstrap.assetIds is the complete, strictly ascending V2 pallet-assets ID set and includes every migrated state asset; fresh assets without a migrated book are declared only here. The contract does not model asset definitions or metadata, so the producer must require the ID sets of assets.assets and assets.metadata each to equal assetIds exactly, with no extra or missing IDs, and migrated metadata decimals equal to the state book.
